summary: The Enhancement Level 60 build with 2 points moved from Ancestral Knowledge into Improved Ghost Wolf for utility. It is 4.0 behind Level 60 at 180 s. On totem duty it also keeps up the party's totems (Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring for the melee party), with the raid's off.
rotation: Pre-pull: starting totems already down (Strength of Earth IV, Windfury Totem, Mana Spring), no mana cost
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down
Searing Totem when it is down and at least 10 s remain
Rage of the Farseer on cooldown, waiting for the on-use trinket; Blood Fury lined up with it
Other cooldowns (Sapper, Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion, Land Mine)
Fire Nova while Clearcasting is up
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Fire Nova while the mana covers 12 a second for the rest of the fight
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 Strength and 14 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Improved Ghost Wolf is utility only (A/B 0.0)
Orc lead is mostly Axe Specialization from the synthetic axe; with weapon racials off Windshaper Skyborne leads
Maelstrom Weapon proc rate (2 PPM per point) is an assumption until beta reaches level 34
Elemental Focus trigger set: if Stormstrike can trigger it, Enhancement gets too few Clearcasting procs
notes: mksettings -spec enh -apl optimized_totem_duty -totems self (the raid has no party totems; the shaman drops Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring Totem itself).
